sections.Profile:
The "Round Up" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Women, Wood Rail, Horses, Guns
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Harry Mabs
- Art: Roy Parker
sections.Editions: - Round Up: 1,500 made, released 1948-11-01, model number 12
